thread:
sara_ml: FYI after yesterday's kernel-selector merge, continuous-batching CI shows elevated p99 on A10 when pack_ratio > 3.0. posting quick profile.
mike_runtime: can you drop the numbers and the profiling command? :eyes:
sara_ml: command i used: ```/opt/prof/run_profile --gpu=A10 --model=llama2-7b --seq=512 --iters=200``` snippet:
avg_tok_latency=42ms p50=38ms p95=62ms p99=89ms
kernel_selected=int8_kv_pack_v2
kv_frag_ratio=0.27
pack_ratio=3.4
jonah_perf: baseline (pre-selector-change) for same job was p99 ~48ms and kernel int8_kv_pack_v1. v2 is causing mid-tail regressions.
lee_infra: infra-bot ran the same profile. infra-bot: artifact uploaded s3://ri-perf/profiles/5099.json
infra-bot: profiling job 5099 finished. Upload: s3://ri-perf/profiles/5099.json
mike_runtime: suspect selector picks a kernel tiling that increases KV cache churn at these pack ratios. can we diff kernel microbenchmarks?
sara_ml: did a quick diff: v2 is ~2-3% lower throughput on 512-token inner loop but uses memory better for very long contexts. regression shows up for mid-size sequences (256-1024) which is common in chat bursts.
jonah_perf: proposed immediate mitigations:
- selector fallback: if pack_ratio in (2.5,4.5) and model=llama2-7b on A10, prefer int8_kv_pack_v1
- reduce default max_tokens_per_batch on A10 from 8192 -> 6144 for safety window
- add per-card pack_ratio telemetry and KV_fragment_ratio gauge
sasha_research: agree. Also we should surface the distribution of pack_ratio per-card; avg_batch_size hides skew. I'll add work to compute p50/p95 pack_ratio metrics.
lee_infra: i'll add metrics: batch_pack_ratio_p50, batch_pack_ratio_p95, kv_fragment_ratio_gauge. target deploy EOD.
mike_runtime: short-term plan: lower A10 cap to 6144 and add selector override behind a runtime flag. longer-term: fix kernel v2 micro-op tiling.
jonah_perf: can you run a quick sim with max_tokens_per_batch=6144 and share numbers?
sara_ml: ran local sim: ```/opt/prof/run_profile --gpu=A10 --model=llama2-7b --seq=512 --max_tokens_per_batch=6144``` results:
avg_tok_latency=41ms p50=37ms p95=59ms p99=54ms
throughput approx unchanged.
jonah_perf: those are convincing for p99. Need to quantify tokens/sec delta and cost impact across mixes before changing prod defaults.
sasha_research: throughput runs show 8192 cap -> 980 tokens/sec, 6144 cap -> 940 tokens/sec (~4% loss) but tail improves ~40%. for SLA-sensitive customers tail reduction is worth it.
mike_runtime: fine. rollout plan:
1) selector override (model+gpu) behind flag
2) lower A10 default max_tokens_per_batch to 6144 in device policy
3) infra metrics deployed to validate
4) jonah to run cluster sweep across A10/T4/L4/A100/H100 and report tokens/sec and p50/p95/p99
lee_infra: metrics PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/metrics/pull/129 -> deploying now
infra-bot: deploy start: metrics/pull/129 -> staging
infra-bot: deploy success: metrics/pull/129 -> staging @ 3276543450
jonah_perf: i'll run a sweep tomorrow capturing: gpu, model, max_tokens_per_batch, chosen_kernel, pack_ratio_p50/p95, kv_frag, tokens/sec, p50/p95/p99. artifacts -> s3/perf/sweeps/3276/
sara_ml: note: L4 behaved differently in microbench — v2 improved tail there. selector rules must be per-gpu-family, not global.
mike_runtime: implemented selector rule pseudo: if gpu==A10 and model in medium_set and pack_ratio in (2.2,4.5) and kv_frag < 0.35 then prefer int8_kv_pack_v1 else allow v2. will gate behind runtime flag.
jonah_perf: adding "selector_version_chosen" to sweep CSV to validate guard logic in staging.
sasha_research: also add a safety in batch-formation: if predicted_pack_ratio > 3.5 for medium models, temporarily bias merging to smaller batches for 1-2s window to avoid forming pathological batches.
mike_runtime: i'll draft the batch-formation patch and a device-policy PR to lower A10 cap. mark hotfix if staging numbers match.
lee_infra: metrics live in staging; infra-bot scheduled profiling job 5100.
infra-bot: profiling job 5100 queued.
infra-bot: profiling job 5100 completed. artifact: s3://ri-perf/profiles/5100.json
sara_ml: profile 5100 confirms p99 ~56ms with cap=6144 and selector guard in place. will keep monitoring during jonah's sweep.
jonah_perf: sweep started. posting link once results aggregated: s3://ri-perf/sweeps/3276/summary.csv
sasha_research: summary of next steps: (1) short-term conservative A10 cap + selector guard, (2) infra metrics to validate pack_ratio distribution, (3) jonah to quantify cost tradeoffs, (4) perf-research to root-cause v2 micro-op regression and iterate.
mike_runtime: sounds good. i'll open PRs for selector-guard and device policy now. tagging for review.
sara_ml: thanks everyone. closing this thread unless sweep shows surprises.
